text_blocks.snippet: Thrush, also known as oral candidiasis, is a fungal infection that can be a sign of HIV infection, especially when it's severe or persistent. While thrush can occur in individuals with healthy immune systems, it's more common and can be more severe in people with weakened immune systems, like those with HIV.
snippet_highlighted_words: Thrush, also known as oral candidiasis, is a fungal infection that can be a sign of HIV infection, especially when it's severe or persistent

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a breakdown of the connection:

list.title: HIV and the Immune System:
list.snippet: HIV attacks the body's immune system, specifically the CD4+ T-cells, making it harder to fight off infections like thrush.

list.title: Thrush as an Indicator:
list.snippet: In HIV-positive individuals, thrush, particularly if it's persistent or severe, can be an early warning sign of declining immune function and a higher risk of developing other opportunistic infections.

list.title: CD4 Count:
list.snippet: The severity of thrush is often linked to the CD4 count, a measure of immune system strength. Low CD4 counts (below 200 cells/milliliter) are associated with a higher risk of more serious infections, including esophageal thrush.

list.title: Types of Thrush:
list.snippet: Different forms of thrush can occur in HIV, including pseudomembranous candidiasis (cottage cheese-like patches), erythematous candidiasis (red lesions), and angular cheilitis (cracking at the corners of the mouth).

list.title: Treatment:
list.snippet: Thrush is typically treated with antifungal medications, such as fluconazole or clotrimazole.

list.title: Importance of Testing:
list.snippet: It's crucial to get tested for HIV if you suspect you have thrush, especially if it's severe or recurrent, as early diagnosis and treatment are vital for managing HIV and preventing further complications.

list.title: HAART and Thrush:
list.snippet: Effective antiretroviral therapy (ART), also known as highly active antiretroviral therapy (HAART), can help restore the immune system and reduce the frequency and severity of thrush episodes in people with HIV.
